dct_creator_sm: Marandino, Christa A (GEOMAR - Helmholtz Centre for Ocean Research Kiel). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9947-4377
dct_description_sm: Carbonate system water samples were collected using a ship-based Seabird SBE911plus CTD-Rosette system onboard RV MARIA S. MERIAN during research cruise MSM123. The samples were preserved with HgCl2 and analyzed in the laboratory within 4 months after the collection for pHtot, Total Alkalinity, Dissolved Inorganic Carbon and delta 13C. The quality of the data was ensured by regular analysis of certified reference material (CRM) supplied by Dickson Lab from the Scripps Institution of Oceanography. Laboratory-measured pH data were converted to in situ values using in-situ temperature, Total Alkalinity, depth, and salinity using the dissociation constants from Lueker (2000) and KS04 of Dickson (1990) and TB of Uppström (1974). Missing values are indicative of either a sample not being collected, a failed analysis, or a broken bottle.
